examples.text: „Die Briefe, so wie sie sind, herauszugeben, erscheint mir untunlich; manches darin ist allzu persönlich und für Dritte völlig gleichgiltig.“
„Ein Alkoholverbot war mit Rücksicht auf die Kälte untunlich.“
That was a most inopportune spot for a picnic.

"It appears I come at an inopportune time, madam," said he, "when my friend, Mr. Rochester, is from home; but I arrive from a very long journey, and I think I may presume so far on old and intimate acquaintance as to install myself here till he returns."

glosses: Happening/occurring at an inconvenient or inappropriate time.

examples.text: The inopportune arrival of the bus cut short the interesting conversation.
